t: Malta Public Transport launches 10th Anniversary Video Competition
html:
Malta Public Transport is inviting the public to share their creativity and storytelling skills by participating in a video competition themed “Malta by Bus”, in celebration of its 10th anniversary, marking a decade of moving people.

The competition, which starts today, offers 250 participants the chance to win fantastic prizes by submitting a short video that captures the experience of travelling around the islands by bus. Whether it is a scenic sunset ride, a quirky moment on board, or a heartfelt tribute to public transport, all styles are welcome.

During the past 10 years, Malta Public Transport carried over 500 million passengers, with 350,000 individual active Tallinja Card users in the past twelve months alone. This competition celebrates the people who use the bus and who have helped Malta Public Transport reach this milestone.

The videos must be between 10 and 20 seconds, filmed in portrait format, and suitable for Instagram Stories, Reels, or TikTok. Entries can be submitted via WhatsApp on +356 9909 7388 by Maltese residents aged 16 and over, and will be accepted until 20 June 2025. 

The top three videos will take home prizes of €500, €250, and €100 respectively in One4All vouchers. The top 250 submissions will also each receive a €20 One4All voucher. Winners will be selected based on creativity, originality, alignment with the theme, and their potential for social media engagement.

All participants must ensure they have obtained the necessary permissions from anyone appearing in their video, and the competition’s full Terms and Conditions can be found on the Malta Public Transport website: publictransport.com.mt.
